title: Vaze Realty: Building an MLS-Integrated Real Estate Platform
cover_alt: Vaze Realty Interactive Map Search and Dashboard Interface
excerpt: A deep dive into engineering the Vaze Realty platform: connecting RESO Web API feeds, custom Google Maps drawing filters, and role-based client portals on WordPress.
body:
Building custom WordPress platforms means delivering systems that solve real operational needs. On Vaze Realty, my work focused on creating dependable architecture, intuitive interfaces, and streamlined automation.

Professional Context: This work was executed during my role as Senior Web Developer at Vaze Realty (Feb 08, 2026 - Present • Active Retainer).

1. Project Overview & Context

A custom real-estate platform with RESO Web API property search, interactive map radius and polygon search tools, role-based dashboards, and lead capture funnels.

2. The Challenge & Requirements

Presenting interactive map property search, radius tools, status indicators, RESO Web API data sync, and client listing views in a clean, high-performance UI.

The goal was to build a reliable solution that internal teams can easily manage while providing end users with a frictionless experience.

3. My Role & Technical Scope

In my position as Senior Web Developer, I was directly responsible for:

  • Custom full-stack WordPress architecture, RESO Web API property sync, interactive polygon & radius Google Maps search UI, role-based dashboards (Agent, Client, Manager), and GoHighLevel / Follow Up Boss lead funnels.
  • Engineering secure data pipelines utilizing WordPress, RESO API, Google Maps API, Follow Up Boss, GoHighLevel.
  • Ensuring WCAG accessibility, responsive viewport scaling, and performant page loads.

4. What I Built & Implemented

Designed custom floating map filter controls, responsive property card grids, protected dashboard views for agents and clients, and automated CRM lead flows.

5. Engineering Best Practices Applied

  • Security First: Strict input sanitization, output escaping, and nonce token verification on all user actions.
  • Decoupled Architecture: Clean separation between business logic and display presentation for long-term maintainability.
  • Performance: Lightweight asset loading and efficient API response caching.

6. Verified Results

The implementation was verified across desktop and mobile browsers and deployed live. It stands as an example of WordPress engineered beyond simple brochure sites into a true business platform.
author: Ian Ceazar A. Escalante

title: Solving Map Marker Clustering & Radius Filtering in Real Estate Search
cover_alt: Vaze Realty Interactive Map Search and Dashboard Interface
excerpt: How we resolved polygon coordinate rendering bottlenecks and optimized dynamic listing card synchronizations during radius and map dragging.
body:
In high-traffic WordPress applications and custom integrations, unexpected edge cases, database latency, and third-party API collisions can introduce friction. Here is how I diagnosed, repaired, and verified the technical solution for Vaze Realty.

Professional Context: This work was executed during my role as Senior Web Developer at Vaze Realty (Feb 08, 2026 - Present • Active Retainer).

1. The Problem & Observed Symptoms

During live operations, we encountered specific performance or workflow obstacles:

Presenting interactive map property search, radius tools, status indicators, RESO Web API data sync, and client listing views in a clean, high-performance UI.

Rather than applying surface-level patches, my objective was identifying the root architectural cause and implementing a permanent, resilient fix.

2. My Diagnostic Process & Technical Role

Serving as Senior Web Developer, I took direct technical ownership of diagnosing and resolving this issue. My scope included:

  • Auditing server logs, HTTP response payloads, and database queries.
  • Isolating execution bottlenecks across WordPress, RESO API, Google Maps API, Follow Up Boss, GoHighLevel.
  • Developing local reproduction tests before deploying fixes to production.

3. What I Fixed & Implemented

Custom full-stack WordPress architecture, RESO Web API property sync, interactive polygon & radius Google Maps search UI, role-based dashboards (Agent, Client, Manager), and GoHighLevel / Follow Up Boss lead funnels.

Designed custom floating map filter controls, responsive property card grids, protected dashboard views for agents and clients, and automated CRM lead flows.

4. Key Engineering Decisions

  • Safe Fallbacks: Ensured graceful error handling so external API downtime never breaks the visitor-facing layout.
  • Database & Memory Hygiene: Eliminated redundant transient queries and optimized database indexing.
  • Code Maintainability: Documented hooks and filter callbacks to make future modifications straightforward.

5. Verified Outcome

The fix was thoroughly tested across staging environments and successfully pushed to production. The workflow now operates smoothly without error spikes or layout inconsistencies.
author: Ian Ceazar A. Escalante
